name: Hootsuite
label: Hootsuite REST — schedule, list, analytics
description: Official Hootsuite REST API 1.0 at https://platform.hootsuite.com/v1. OfficialApiNode: POST /messages, GET /messages, POST /analytics/posts. Auth is StudioQuack secret access_token (Bearer). trigger is BPMN message-event ingress (com.hootsuite.messages.event.v1), not a socket. Analytics needs Advanced Analytics and scope analytics:read. Customer owns the Developer Portal app. Never log access_token.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: message_schedule | message_list | analytics_get | trigger.

schema.label: scheduledSendTime
schema.description: message_schedule body. UTC ISO-8601 ending in Z, at least 5 minutes ahead (videos: at least 15 minutes).

schema.label: socialProfileIds
schema.description: message_schedule body. Array of Hootsuite profile ids (not socialNetworkId). Resolve via GET /v1/socialProfiles.

schema.label: startTime
schema.description: message_list query. ISO-8601. Required with endTime. Window max 4 weeks.

schema.label: endTime
schema.description: message_list query. ISO-8601. Not later than startTime + 4 weeks.

schema.label: filters
schema.description: analytics_get body. Profile ids (max 10), reporting period (≤ 2 years), network type per Analytics docs.

schema.label: State
schema.description: message_list state. EXACT: SCHEDULED | PENDING_APPROVAL | SENT | DELETED.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). trigger returns an ingress instruction, not HTTP. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: message_schedule | message_list | analytics_get | trigger.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: Hootsuite OAuth access token (StudioQuack secret). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Never log or place on INPUT. Empty → no HTTP. Refresh tokens are single-use — rotate out of band.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 30. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
